description: Prevent integration breakage between services with contract testing: consumer-driven contracts with Pact (consumer tests, provider states, provider verification, broker workflow, pending pacts, can-i-deploy) and schema-first contracts with OpenAPI (breaking-change diffing, schema-conformance testing with Schemathesis). Includes matcher strategy, versioning and deploy-gating, and when contracts are the wrong tool. Use when separately deployed consumers and providers (microservices, mobile apps vs API, event/message consumers) break each other in integration or when end-to-end tests are slow and flaky. Do NOT use for in-process integration tests (integration-testing), API design itself (api-design), gRPC schema evolution (grpc-protobuf), or browser E2E (playwright-testing).
